readerCopy.body: A strategy built to avoid criticism can end up sitting directly across from the desire or boundary that no longer fits inside it. When Chiron opposes Lilith, protection and autonomy face each other directly, exposing how much a role, habit, or agreeable persona may have been organized around preventing one old reaction. The protection may have worked and still be too expensive now. The tension clarifies what would be chosen if the old source of judgment no longer got the first vote.
